name: esp32-s3-devkit
description: An ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 with every header pin on the block edge, USB at the top, and the pins conucon's Logic Module reserves on an S3 (native USB, and everything not brought out) marked as such. Connect over Web Serial, detect the chip, and flash the ESP32-S3 build of logicMod from the browser.

logicalPorts.description: GPIO16 — CAN RX by default (see the CAN block)
